items.title: Top AI for the Art. Cheap AI for the Code.
items.summary: In episode 1031 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Ish Shah, Director at Dell how different AI models are suited for different tasks, highlighting the "jagged frontier" of AI. He explains that top-tier models are essential for high-quality artwork, while simpler, more cost-effective models suffice for coding tasks. This approach optimizes resource use by matching model complexity to specific needs.
